exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
Type of health facility (public vs. private)
cohort: 894 recently delivered mothers in Bahir Dar city, Ethiopia
finding: The overall maternal delivery care service satisfaction level was low (61.4%), with higher satisfaction among vaginal deliveries (65.6%) compared to cesarean sections (57.2%).
mod_finding: Mothers were more satisfied with vaginal delivery care than cesarean section delivery care.
